item.title: 5 Signs You Need To Hire A Project Manager
item.dc:creator: nick@digital-progress.co.uk
item.itunes:title: 5 Signs You Need To Hire A Project Manager
item.itunes:summary: In this episode, Greg Wilkes lays out a clear framework for construction business owners to identify when it’s time to bring in a Project Manager – and how doing so can transform your operations, profit, and personal life. If you're overwhelmed and your business feels stuck or chaotic, this episode gives you the insight to know when and how to act.
item.itunes:author: Greg Wilkes

item.title: How to Step Off The Tools
item.dc:creator: nick@digital-progress.co.uk
item.itunes:title: How to Step Off The Tools
item.itunes:summary: In this episode, Greg lays out a powerful plan for construction business owners who want to stop working on the tools and start leading like a true CEO. If you’re still swinging a hammer and chasing jobs day-to-day, this episode will help you shift gears – practically and mentally – so you can build a business that runs without you.
item.itunes:author: Greg Wilkes

item.title: How to Build a Construction Team That Runs Your Business Without You
item.dc:creator: nick@digital-progress.co.uk
item.itunes:title: How to Build a Construction Team That Runs Your Business Without You
item.itunes:summary: In this episode, Greg shares a practical roadmap for construction business owners who want to escape daily operations by building a team that runs the business without them. He breaks down the key shifts required to scale beyond £1 million, reduce stress, and reclaim personal freedom.
item.itunes:author: Greg Wilkes

item.title: Get CITB Funding With Deb Madden & Nathan Wilkins
item.dc:creator: nick@digital-progress.co.uk
item.itunes:title: Get CITB Funding With Deb Madden & Nathan Wilkins
item.itunes:summary: In this episode, Greg sits down with Deb Madden, Executive Director at CITB, and Nathan Wilkins, Customer Engagement Manager, to uncover how construction business owners can access CITB funding to train, upskill, and grow their teams. They break down exactly how to claim grants, access training, and make the most of CITB support.
item.itunes:author: Greg Wilkes

item.itunes:author: Greg Wilkes
